entry.title: Enhance Japanese tutorial site with new features and content
entry.content:
Enhance Japanese tutorial site with new features and content

- Added user preference and workspace facts sections in AGENTS.md
- Updated astro.config.mjs to include React integration and sidebar structure
- Expanded lesson content and sidebar links for improved navigation
- Introduced new components: AudioPlayer, ContinueLearning, FlashCard, KnowledgeCheck, LessonFooter, ProgressTracker, QuickRecall, and ReadingTime
- Implemented progress tracking and user engagement features
- Updated README.md with deployment instructions and project structure
- Enhanced TypeScript configuration for React support

entry.title: Initial commit: Japanese tutorial site (Astro Starlight)
entry.content:
Initial commit: Japanese tutorial site (Astro Starlight)

- 27 pages covering hiragana, katakana, kanji, grammar, and travel Japanese
- Targeted at Mandarin speakers learning Japanese
- Built with Astro 7 + Starlight, deployed to Cloudflare Pages
